[NSTG.6.1] Across all storage callbacks, the
ownership / lifetime rules:

| Pointer | Owner | Valid for |
|---|---|---|
| the write (`ds_cache_write_t`) on cache set | dispatcher | callback duration |
| `key` (cache) | dispatcher | callback duration |
| `value` on cache | dispatcher | callback duration |
| `removal` on cache delete | dispatcher | callback duration |
| Service, correlation and every argument (name and value, including an encoded fact's bytes) on call | dispatcher | callback duration |
